# Request header injection variants

Whole JavaScript inputs preserve send-hook factories, captured native helpers and
header callbacks for injectRequestHeadersBeforeSend recognition.

[The integration target](../../naming_inject_request_headers_variants.rs) accepts
[branch-assigned-inline-carrier.js](branch-assigned-inline-carrier.js) and
[single-assignment-helper-carrier.js](single-assignment-helper-carrier.js).
The inline source also supplies a control in
[carrier analysis tests](../../../src/signals/analysis/roles/carriers.rs).

[dead-inline-carrier-callback.js](dead-inline-carrier-callback.js),
[self-argument-escape.js](self-argument-escape.js) and
[early-alias-call.js](early-alias-call.js) are refusal inputs. They independently
exercise dormant callback work, escaping native helper aliases and activation
before initialization. Additional in-memory controls vary header receivers,
null guards, callback phase and ordered multi-hop aliases.

Preserve complete parent scopes, helper origins, effect order and exact mutation
anchors. A valid parse/model is required even for a refused candidate. Do not run
or reformat these recovered programs, or replace a negative with its baseline.
